title: Rappels
description: Exemple de tableau de bord : rappels en cours, par liste et à venir

blocks.title: Rappels en cours
blocks.sql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM reminders WHERE done_at IS NULL AND archived_at IS NULL

blocks.title: En retard
blocks.sql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM reminders WHERE done_at IS NULL AND archived_at IS NULL AND due_at < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')

blocks.title: Rappels en cours par liste
blocks.sql: SELECT list AS x, count(*) AS y FROM reminders WHERE done_at IS NULL AND archived_at IS NULL GROUP BY list ORDER BY y DESC, list

blocks.title: Prochaines échéances
blocks.sql: SELECT id, title, list, due_at FROM reminders WHERE done_at IS NULL AND archived_at IS NULL AND due_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY due_at LIMIT 10
